decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds directly on the firm's established office and conference expertise, so it can read market feedback well and refine the system through its own R&D.
A chair family sits at the core of the firm's upholstery and craftsmanship knowledge, which supports a long life cycle typical of premium German furniture lines.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche crossover with limited related knowledge behind them, which makes them the most vulnerable, but they still link to the rug line and cost little to maintain.
A designer sofa developed with a long-standing design partner is closest to the firm's core competence and is actively promoted as new, so it should stay.
The high standing table extends the firm's conference and lounge table expertise and complements its workplace offer, so keeping it is justified despite modest strategic weight.
Although rugs are distant from the core, the firm presents the collection as a flagship and has built material and designer collaboration around it, so it keeps investing to absorb the new knowledge.
